decision: Cache fresh decoded buffer bytes before hex conversion; destination is loop-invariant because no resize or escape occurs. Shared C/LLVM native implementation; no backend/name special cases or optimization/alias/alignment/inline flags changed. Preserve validation, allocation order, error/ownership/length semantics.

causal_evidence.old_conversion: Scalar unrolled loop in saved runtime IR; no already-vectorized marker on conversion. Late vectorizer cannot identify array bounds and reports potentially faulting load. Disabling early vectorizers or using runtime -O1 does not restore vectorized conversion.
causal_evidence.new_conversion: Runtime Clang -O3 remarks at runtime.c:3400 report vectorization width 32, interleave 1. Native adapter IR loads output pointer before loop; reads <64 x i8>, shuffles even/odd digits, stores <32 x i8>; also 8-byte vector epilogue and scalar tail. First validation loop remains early-exit scalar.

stable_output.change: Cache newly allocated output bytes pointer before hex conversion loop; all validation and allocation/checks unchanged.

production.methodology: CPU 0; 16 balanced cyclic/reversed rounds; same fixed call counts as staging controls; fresh wait4-supervised children; validate every checksum; baseline executables reused without rebuild; elapsed includes startup/dispatch/shutdown. Negative paired change is faster.

hardware_counters.methodology: CPU 0; six alternating paired rounds; perf stat user-mode cycles, instructions, branches and branch misses; no multiplexing; every stdout checksum checked.

map_identical_executable_controls.methodology: 32 balanced cyclic/reversed rounds; CPU0; two labels for each exact executable (no copies/builds); 4851 calls; every checksum validated. Identical-byte controls quantify map process variation, not another optimization.

sanitizer_smoke.cases: empty; 1/15/16/17/31/32/33/63/64/65/255/256/257 decoded bytes; all 256 byte values; uppercase; odd length, invalid digit, NUL, Unicode, invalid late digit and late odd length

limits: One Linux x86-64 host; Clang22.1.8/llvm-link22.1.0; CPU0; no cross-target performance guarantee.

Hashmap first production batch +7.01% elapsed and +10.18% cycles, but follow-up 32-round duplicate-label controls gave -0.40% and +1.20% old/new paired changes; no reproducible map performance conclusion.
C text/rodata are byte-identical; nonzero C elapsed deltas are process/measurement variation. Other small elapsed movements are not attributed to hex conversion.
LLVM text-category size grows 1280 bytes; GNU size includes read-only sections; allocations count calls, not bytes.
